Route GitHub-backed runtime workspace writes to a dedicated runtime branch by default.

Default runtime branch: runtime-observation-state.

This keeps dev/v2-start as the code branch while preserving Observation/nervous-system journal writes outside the code branch.

No change to Observation validation or sanitization.
